summary: Add an interaction-mode framework and implement Presentation mode: continuous ambient understanding and speculative preparation, priority explicit commands, quiet-by-default output, fact-check alerts, and a left-side mode selector independent from voice architecture.
locked_constraints: Interaction mode is orthogonal to Simple/Front Brain/Duplex voice architecture.
SIMPLE is the current assistant behavior and remains the default.
PRESENTATION is implemented by this task.
REUNION is visible as future/reserved in V1; do not invent meeting behavior.
Ambient presentation speech never directly authorizes actions.
Wake word and the configured manual wake key create a priority addressed turn that never waits for ambient-analysis backlog.
Presentation background work may delegate to sub-agents and prepare documents, web results, data, charts, or scene artifacts.
Visual commands are silent by default; genuine knowledge questions may speak when speech adds value.
Fact-check contradictions create a discreet sound plus floating visual attention signal, never unsolicited spoken interruption in V1.
Maintain a bounded session working set plus a fresher recent transcript tail; neither is long-term memory.
Speculative work is lower priority and may be preempted/deprioritized for explicit interaction.
Existing Simple behavior, wake-key behavior outside Presentation, scene authority rules, and persistent-write confirmation rules must not regress.
planning_blockers: Workspace Task Type vocabulary is not exposed; Slice 00 must assign valid existing Task Types before implementation dispatch or obtain an explicit waiver.
